entries.title: The merge button says what your merge waits for
entries.body: While a pull request's checks are still running, the button on its card now reads Merge when checks pass: clicking it keeps your merge, and the app merges the pull request by itself once the checks pass. Once the checks have failed, it reads Merge after fixing errors: your merge waits for a fix, which brings a new version with fresh checks, and if the fix changes the work, its crewmate asks you again on a new card. The activity line after the click says which one your merge is waiting for. Once the checks pass, the button reads Merge the pull request again.

picture.alt: A completion card whose checks are still running, with its button reading Merge when checks pass beside Discard.
